variants.name: Chicken, 10 pcs / 55 g
variants.about_this_item: 8in1 Delights Chicken Twisted Sticks are made of tasty beefhide and delicious chicken breast for intensive, long-lasting chewing fun. While keeping your dog busy, the natural abrasive action of chewing helps remove tartar and supports dental health. Low in fat, rich in protein, oven baked, free from artificial colours and flavour enhancers, with no added sugar, GMOs, gluten or grains. Pack of 10 sticks, 55 g.
variants.feeding_instructions: XS dogs (1–5 kg): feed 1 treat over a course of two days; do not exceed 1 treat in a two day period. S–L dogs (5+ kg): feed 1–2 treats per day; do not exceed two treats in a single day. Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily caloric intake. Always provide fresh water and supervise your dog while chewing.
